info.title: Tarjetas API
info.description: Versioned cookie-authenticated API. Ownership resolves on server. Receipt upload and correction require trusted ingress metadata and fail closed without it. Domain errors use Error; invalid fields use Laravel 422 message/errors.

get.description: Public liveness. No database, session, cookies or private storage. CORS remains enabled.

204.description: Session and readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie established

post.description: Existing accounts only. Regenerates session ID. No token issuance or remember login. Five attempts per minute per IP/email.

get.description: Owner-resolved cards, catalog, actual report months, reference readiness and retained objects. Missing references do not block evidence workflows.

Resolve a persisted reference inside the authenticated ledger. Verify hash and size. PDF inline; other bytes attachment. private/no-store and nosniff. Never accepts a filesystem path. SPA fetches a credentialed blob.

parameters.name: journal
parameters.description: Show one owned posted journal, regardless of ordinary pagination. Unknown/other-owner UUID returns 404.

get.description: Native owner balances and paginated immutable journals. Balance cents are signed decimal integer strings, independent of presentation valuation. No journal editing.
Owner-resolved source revision or occurrence. Full retained source fields, admission, timestamps and document digest. Unknown/other-owner evidence is 404.

post.description: One Coto PDF, at most 40 MiB. Original bytes and OCR transcript retained privately. Verification failure is retained before returning 422. Accepted bytes deduplicate before OCR. Requires trusted deadline from before buffering; caller stamps are ignored. Exactly one file; at most 32 multipart parts and 1 MiB total framing/non-file data. Extra/nested/duplicate files return 400 invalid_upload_envelope; excess framing/fields return 413 too_large.

post.description: Expected latest decision is mandatory, null for first link. Item allocations require reviewed canonical and individual identity; remainder stays Unallocated. Receipt-first requires actual card and full payment verification. Statement-first uses existing acquisition. Ambiguity reviews do not fabricate purchases.

paymentVerified.description: Explicit verification of full payment with the selected actual card. Reconciliation that would relink an unlinked receipt or resume an unverified receipt-funded link requires true and a non-null cardId; otherwise HTTP 400 receipt_payment_unresolved is returned without changing finances or link history.

expectedPurchaseVersion.description: Observed purchaseVersion from receipt detail. Required and non-null when applying allocation or nonempty itemAllocations to an existing purchase. Missing or stale versions return HTTP 409 stale_purchase_version. Initial funding may use null. When non-null for association-only reconciliation, it must match the selected purchase.

allocation.description: Explicit aggregate correction. To reset all items to Unallocated, submit the full receipt total to expense:unallocated with purpose unallocated, and itemAllocations: []. Null without nonempty itemAllocations makes no financial correction. A full reset to Unallocated does not require approving untouched product identities and does not change their review status; other aggregate classifications require all item identities reviewed.

post.description: Append unlink history, preserving expense and preventing automatic relinking.

Duplicate bytes/renamed replay produce no new journals; changed facts remain pending and preserve the accepted revision. Same document cannot switch actual cards. Filename is validated and retained; Mercado Pago requires a year in it. Exactly one file; at most 32 multipart parts and 1 MiB total framing/non-file data. get.description: Owner-only retained Coto source observations, current receipts, financial links, historical associations and both immutable histories. Missing/ambiguous links remain distinct.

post.description: Separate evidence-only association. Requires accepted current-owner receipt and actual statement source/card, positive ARS and no USD, first installment or one-off, three-day date window and exact documented cent tolerance. Refuses ownership stealing and conflicting financial associations. Unlink appends a decision without removing financial entries. Stale history returns 409.

post.description: Narrow explicit full refund of a retained pre-opening one-off acquisition. Requires accepted matching owner/card/currency/source, supported original date/cycle and equal full amount, a post-opening refund, no fabricated/posted original purchase, and expense leaf/purpose. Partial or mismatched refunds fail. One opening plus one credit journal; replay never posts again.

get.description: Read-only analytical projection over the authenticated owner repeatable-read PostgreSQL snapshot. Native cents remain integers; derived display values preserve floating precision. No fixture, owner, facts, references or snapshot flag is accepted from the browser. Unknown modes normalize to purchase/real/excl/month. Route controls constrain grouping; categories/sankey invalid period defaults to latest, merchants defaults to all. Empty private ledgers return data=null and meta.empty=true without reference/helper prerequisites. Missing references on populated reports fail explicitly. Rates use constituent purchase/billing months before aggregation. Native USD is excluded from ordinary peso spending and remains visible in the special currency split. Supermarket money fields are display-restated at each receipt month for real/USD modes; quantities/tags/dates stay unchanged. The separate account allocation matrix always retains native ARS cents.

parameters.name: day
parameters.description: Calendar day selection; unknown valid dates select the newest available day.

post.description: Append a reviewed/dismissed/reopened alert annotation without changing money. Recompute the alert within the caller ledger under a transaction lock; unknown/other-owner exclusive keys return 404. Shared computed keys resolve to the caller. Expected latest decision is mandatory; stale decisions return 409. A language change does not change command semantics.

get.description: Current caller-owned canonical products, chain codes, ordered rules, accepted receipt items/matches, review history (latest 100), and opaque optimistic fingerprint. Printed item fields are immutable.

post.description: Ordered Coto substring rule create/edit/disable or explicit receipt rematch. Codes take precedence over rules. Rematch invalidates item approvals, retains original facts and financial journals, and checks the exact current queue fingerprint. Existing product/update/item/code/merge operations use /product-reviews.

200.description: Immutable review decision, affectedIds and duplicate status

get.description: Caller-owned current merchant families, supported purchases with complete current native versions, ordered rules and latest 100 decisions. Source labels remain literal. No mutation. Historical acquisition observations include only eligible retained pre-opening sources and their latest classification decision; they are distinct from native purchases.

post.description: Requires Idempotency-Key. selected corrects only this purchase; future_rule changes no historical posting; matching_history requires exact owner/card preview IDs, explicit confirmation and fingerprint including purchase versions/principals. Corrections retain original effective dates and evidence; merchant family merges retain descriptions and alter no journals.

Owned historical source-only classification. Changes acquisition report labels without posting purchases, changing opening debt or rewriting evidence. Matching history requires exact current source IDs, explicit confirmation and preview fingerprint. Future rules leave history intact.

Owned historical source-only classification. Changes acquisition report labels without posting purchases, changing opening debt or rewriting evidence. Matching history requires exact current source IDs, explicit confirmation and preview fingerprint. Future rules leave history intact.

get.description: Credentialed download of only the resolved caller ledger financial rows and owner-qualified retained documents. Excludes users, credentials, sessions and other authentication state. This is not an administrator recovery archive. Private temporary file is deleted after sending.

post.description: Read-only exact affected family, target identity and historical/native fact identities. A new merchant, target revision or affected fact invalidates confirmation.

get.description: Current owner-qualified immutable proposal revisions. Includes historical acquisitions without creating native purchases.

post.description: Optional disabled-by-default provider. Only deduplicated sanitized merchant names cross the boundary, max 200. Long identifiers removed; money/rate/percentage-shaped names refused. Validates response names, native leaf targets and finite confidence. No automatic posting. Pending/rejected names suppressed. Deterministic provider injection requires an approved synthetic target; no live provider/key required.

503.description: proposals_unavailable or proposal_service_failed; manual review remains available

post.description: Human account/purpose/scope selection required for acceptance, independently of suggestion/confidence. Uses purchase-version or historical-source CAS and exact scope previews. A conflicting owned future rule cannot be overwritten by an unrelated proposal. Reject appends immutable suppression; it changes no financial journal.

csrf.description: Decoded readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie. Required on unsafe SPA requests.

purchaseVersion.description: Current version of the linked or previously unlinked purchase; null when none exists. Return this observed value as expectedPurchaseVersion for allocation corrections.

nativePurpose.description: Categories only: whole-card native period expense/repayment and closing debt, independent of analytical valuation/drill. Exact aggregate cents are decimal integer strings.
